correctness.rationale: For all n>=3 and 1<=b<=2n-1 the proof derives an exact four-status grounded trace by Schur reduction, a strictly improving local exchange, exact convexity and discrete inequality in the low-budget case, and a strictly decreasing residual objective in the high-budget case. The no-integer-tie claim follows from P_n(b) modulo n and exact endpoint evaluations. Replayed verification checked six symbolic identities, 1932 rational budget problems, 5432 dense leader sets and 468 exact orbit inverses. Enumeration is only corroborative.

value.rationale: For a natural clique-with-private-leaves graph family and every nontrivial leader budget, the theorem completely classifies optimal noise-free leader sets and their exact counts, reduces combinatorial selection to a quadratic sign test, identifies a sharp asymptotic type transition at fraction sqrt(3)-1, and proves a structural nonoverlap exchange. Its scope is substantive and motivated by known leader-selection complexity; the result is not a bare numerical lookup or a standard direct normalization identity.
